emptyStats: VAGUE: 'Stats' doesn't say what stats. Returns {matchedObserved:0, matchedPresumed:0, mismatched:0, neverObserved:0} — these are line-verdict counters.
buildVerifyResult: VAGUE: 'VerificationResult' doesn't say what's being verified. It compares replayed content against on-disk content and returns {filename, totalEdits, kept, ignored, match, replayedContent, diff}.
contextEntry: VAGUE: 'ContextEntry' doesn't say what kind of context. It builds one evidence entry from a structured-patch context line (with hunk/line ref).
characterizationFixture: VAGUE: 'CharacterizationData' doesn't describe the fixture. It builds a multi-format read-tool-use/result sequence (tab, box, trail, plain, error) for the read-event-scanner tests.
textBlockResult: VAGUE: 'TextBlockResult' doesn't say where it's searching. It finds the first {type:'text'} block inside a tool_result's content array and returns {property, text}.
buildSub: VAGUE: 'Sub' is meaningless. It builds the sub-event payload {firstLine, lineCount, hitEof} for a bashReadChunk event.
buildSeeds: VAGUE: 'Seeds' doesn't say seeds for what. It builds the initial file-path search list (the target path plus all historical names from file-path-history).
buildGitOpts: VAGUE: 'GitOpts' is abbreviated. Returns {repo, branch} resolved from CLI args falling back to JSONL session metadata.
buildChips: VAGUE: 'Chips' means nothing without context. It builds the filter-bar UI chips from the fieldIndex keys.
chunkEntries: VAGUE: 'ChunkEntries' doesn't say what entries. Builds per-line entries [{lineNum, text, startIndex, endIndex}] from a bash-read chunk text.
chunkEvent: VAGUE: 'ChunkEvent' is a test fixture builder. Specifically builds a bashReadChunk kind-event fixture with {firstLine, lineCount, hitEof}.
pair: VAGUE: 'Pair' says nothing. It builds a timestamped [bashCommandLine, bashCatToolResult] two-element array linked by tool_use_id.
onDiskSource: VAGUE: 'OnDiskSource' is a test fixture builder. Returns {name:'onDisk', available, content, path} — a reference source fixture for provenance tests.
snapshotSource: VAGUE: 'SnapshotSource' is a test fixture builder. Returns {name:'snapshot', available, content, blob} — a reference source fixture.
snapshotRecord: VAGUE: 'SnapshotRecord' doesn't say what kind of record. Returns a JSONL record of type 'file-history-snapshot' with messageId, timestamp, and trackedFileBackups.
snapshotContext: VAGUE: 'SnapshotContext' is a test fixture. Returns {aliasSet, aliasPaths, sessionId, snapshotsBase} — the context object snapshot-events tests pass to the API.
snapshotEvent: VAGUE: 'SnapshotEvent' is a test fixture. Writes content to a temp blob file and returns {snapshot:{blob}, unixMs:1}.
snapshotLine: VAGUE: 'SnapshotLine' doesn't say what kind of line. Returns a JSON-stringified JSONL line of type 'file-history-snapshot'.
snapshotDedupKey: VAGUE: 'DedupKey' doesn't say what's being deduped. Returns 'messageId|timestamp' — the key that identifies duplicate resume-copied snapshots.
failingRecord: VAGUE: 'FailingRecord' doesn't say what kind of record fails. Returns a probe result record with status:'MISMATCH'.
passingRecord: VAGUE: same pattern. Returns a probe result record with status:'MATCH'.
authoredEntryFor: VAGUE: 'AuthoredEntry' doesn't say what's being authored. Clones a freshEntry and adds {findings, relevantPipelineSourceFiles} — a report entry.
touchForResult: VAGUE: 'Touch' and 'Result' are both generic. Extracts a {kind:'bashread', path, line} touch from a tool_result item.
resultEntry: VAGUE: 'ResultEntry' doesn't say what kind of result. (Grep returned no definition — may be a method or dynamically assigned.)
resultKey: VAGUE: 'ResultKey' doesn't say what it keys. (Same — no grep match for function definition.)
firstAvailableSource: VAGUE: 'Source' doesn't say what kind. These are reference sources (on-disk/snapshot/git) for reconstruction provenance.
firstMatchingSource: VAGUE: same. Finds the first reference source whose content matches the replayed content.
firstMatchingLine: VAGUE: 'Line' doesn't say what's being matched. Finds the first touch line whose path is in the alias set.
firstTextItem: VAGUE: 'TextItem' doesn't say where. Searches a message.content array for the first item with type:'text'.
stepSource: VAGUE: 'StepSource' doesn't say what source means. Returns 'user' or 'toolUseResult' — the edit source discriminator.
renderSegmentList: VAGUE: 'SegmentList' doesn't say what segments. These are conversation segments in the all-lines view rendered to HTML.
parsedFrom: VAGUE: 'RecordsFrom' doesn't say what's being parsed. Maps JSON.parse over an array of JSONL line strings.
renderStepList: VAGUE: 'StepList' doesn't say what steps. These are reconstruction step rows in the viewer.
parseLinesToRecords: VAGUE: 'Records' is generic. Parses raw line strings into JSON objects.
compareLine: VAGUE: 'evaluateLine' doesn't say evaluate against what. Compares a belief line against reference content for the verdict.
collectEditBadges: PRECISION: needed 'file' qualifier — these badges show which files were edited within a segment.
classifySubtype: PRECISION: 'Subtype' of what? These are JSONL line subtypes (user-prompt, tool-use, thinking, etc).
formatContentLabel: PRECISION: 'Content' of what? It's extracting the first 80 chars of a JSONL line's message content as a preview.
extractToolName: PRECISION: 'ToolName' from where? From the tool_use content block of a JSONL line.
formatLineLabel: PRECISION: 'Line' is ambiguous. It's a JSONL line label in the alllines view.
formatSegmentLabel: PRECISION: 'Segment' needs qualifier. It's a conversation segment header label.
buildSegments: PRECISION: 'Segments' of what? These are conversation grouping segments in the alllines view.
renderRow: PRECISION: 'Row' of what? It's one JSONL line's row in the alllines view.
renderSegment: PRECISION: what segment? A conversation segment in the alllines view.
renderBranch: PRECISION: what branch? A rewind branch (old/active) in the alllines view.
renderWithBranches: PRECISION: what branches? The full alllines view with rewind branches interleaved.
buildVisibleTree: PRECISION: 'VisibleTree' of what? It builds the visible conversation tree (viewer-tree-build.js).
verifyAllJsonlFiles: PRECISION: verify against what? Against the on-disk file state.
buildGitRefCandidates: PRECISION: 'Candidates' is vague. It's a prioritized fallback list (branch → origin/branch → HEAD → main → master).
splitParsedLinesIntoTurns: PRECISION: 'turns' of what? Conversation turns split at boundary lines.
